title: Appendix B. Critical corrections and design requirements
tables: Original/tempting claim
Correct APEX XR requirement
Sub-micron whole-plate accuracy
State that telecentric optics reduce perspective error; validate system accuracy, repeatability and uncertainty.
BME690 identifies bacteria
Use only as auxiliary VOC fingerprinting after application-specific controlled training/validation.
VL53L8CX maps colony topography
Use for coarse depth/positioning; use a dedicated profilometer for research-grade 3D.
Load cell measures microgram biomass
Use for gravimetric QC, gross dispensing/spill checks and evaporation/desiccation trends.
AI derives exact MIC from a zone
Use broth microdilution for direct MIC; zone-to-MIC prediction remains research.
RAG reads a PDF and creates a breakpoint
Use a licensed, reviewed, version-controlled structured rules database.
All clinical results in six hours
Claim only method-specific turnaround demonstrated under validated/RAST-compliant workflows.
The device is definitely Class B
Define intended use and obtain formal regulatory classification; keep RUO and clinical configurations separate.
APEX is a biosafety cabinet
Explicitly state it is not; design for use within appropriate laboratory containment and procedures.
